subject: maths
question: The circumference of a circle is equal to the perimeter of an equilateral triangle. If the radius of the circle is 84 cm, then what will be the length of each side of the equilateral triangle? [Use π = (22)/(7)]
solution:
Given:

r = 84

Formula used:

Circumference of circle = 2πr where, r = Radius

The perimeter of an equilateral triangle = 3a where a = side.

Calculation:

Circumference of circle = 2πr

⇒ 2 × 22/7 × 84

⇒ 528 cm

⇒ P = 3a

⇒ 528 = 3a

⇒ a = 176

**∴ Option 2 is the correct answer.**
